meta.title: About — Signal
meta.description: How this template is built: static pages, React views without JavaScript, a Cloudflare Worker in front of the assets, Markdown for agents.

title: About
lead: This template is the base of The Boring Stuff's websites. It takes an architecture already in production and removes every piece of client content.

sections.title: Static first
sections.text: Every page is prerendered at build time. A route can switch to server rendering with prerender = false when it really needs to.

sections.title: For humans and agents
sections.text: Every page also exists as Markdown, listed in llms.txt. An agent that asks for text/markdown gets it at the same address.

sections.title: Deployed by CI
sections.text: A pull request opens a Cloudflare preview; a merge to main goes live. Nothing is deployed from a machine.
